label: bigram "u l" at original position 2 ("_ u l")
explanation: Fires only in the original phase, mostly at t=2 (92% of mass) and some at t=3, when the input is l right after u (99% of mass has in_tok=l and prev_tok=u). Top activations are all sequences starting "b u l". Magnitude depends a lot on the first token: b gives the max, other letters such as e, f, d, k give mid values, and v, z, k, p give near-zero values. Many "x u l" sequences at t=2 are silent (for example c, t, x, o, r, or a digit before "u l"), so precision is about 0.63. Weak activations also occur for "u u l" or "b u l" at t=3, and for "b u" followed by n, s, or h. Never fires at the delimiter, in the copy phase, or at t=0, 1, or 4 and later.
